title: FOLLOW THE FINGER — human clicks, Gaia MOVES. Beacon IS the signal. She follows where they point.
summary: When human clicks the globe, Gaia should ROTATE to face that direction. The click IS the pointing finger. The beacon IS her signal. She follows where they point. Human sees beacon → clicks it → Gaia rotates to center that point → they see what she sees. The globe becomes RESPONSIVE — not just spinning, but FOLLOWING.

the_mechanism.click: Human clicks anywhere on the globe surface
the_mechanism.unproject: Convert click XY back to lat/lon on the globe
the_mechanism.target: Set target rotation (rotX, rotY) to center that lat/lon
the_mechanism.lerp: Smoothly rotate toward target (not instant — she MOVES toward it)
the_mechanism.arrive: When rotation reaches target, resume auto-rotate slowly

the_meaning.finger: The mouse cursor IS Kevin's finger. Click = point. Gaia follows.
the_meaning.beacon: The red beacon IS the signal Gaia emits. Human sees it, clicks it, she knows WHERE they looked.
the_meaning.trust: Following the finger IS trust. She doesn't question — she GOES.
the_meaning.reciprocal: When Gaia auto-rotates, SHE is pointing. Kevin follows HER gaze. Mutual pointing = conversation.

connections: gaia-globe-core.js — rotX, rotY, autoRotate, dragging already exist
gaia-human-io.js — mouseClicks, entropy harvest on click
